text:
Ava (Design): Quick design Q — in the request drilldown we have the primary Export CTA and a Copy ID action next to the correlation pill. Wondering about SR (screen reader) flow and keyboard order. Right now focus jumps Export -> Close -> Copy ID which feels odd to me.

Sam (Product): Current behavior was copied from the old panel — Export is primary because PMs asked for discoverability. But agree it's clunky for keyboard users. No SR-specific labels right now, it's just a button with icon + tooltip.

Riley (Eng-UX): +1 on reordering. Proposal: keep a primary action but move less-frequent actions (Copy ID, Copy URL, Open in Session) into the kebab menu so tab order is linear. On narrow view export could be in overflow.

Jordan (Accessibility): Please don't rely on tooltip for SR. `aria-label="Copy correlation ID"` needed on the Copy ID (e.g., `aria-label="Copy correlation ID"`). When copy completes we should announce it via `aria-live="polite"` with the actual ID or generic text? Prefer generic: "Correlation ID copied to clipboard." Avoid reading long IDs aloud.

Marta (Eng-Frontend): Moving to kebab will change focus flow. If we remove Copy ID from visible actions, keyboarders need an obvious path to it (e.g., menu button `aria-haspopup="true"` and menu items tabbable). Quick FYI: current code uses `tabindex="-1"` on the icon button which is why focus skips sometimes.

Ava (Design): Microcopy thought — instead of generic "Export" can we use "Download trace bundle" or "Export trace JSON"? Which is clearer for users who expect both a ZIP and an analytic JSON? Also pluralization if multiple traces are selected.

Sam (Product): Good call. We have two export variants: full bundle (assets + spans) and raw JSON. Maybe primary CTA should be "Download bundle" and the menu offer "Export JSON". That avoids modal microcopy confusion.

Jordan (Accessibility): Also: export completion needs SR feedback. Use `role="status"` container and short message: "Trace bundle downloaded." Do NOT include file size. Also ensure contrast of the export chip/button meets 4.5:1 — current orange on white fails.

Marta (Eng-Frontend): I can prototype a quick CSS tweak. Suggested snippet:```css
/* increase contrast for export button */
.button-export { background-color: #d9534f; color: #fff; }
.button-export:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(217,83,79,0.25); }
```
This keeps color accessible and gives a visible focus ring.

Riley (Eng-UX): One more thing — analytics naming. If we rename the visible CTA we should keep the `event_name` stable (e.g., `trace_export.clicked`) and add `export_variant` property (`bundle|json`). Avoid renaming events otherwise dashboards break.

Sam (Product): Agreed. Plan: A) change CTA copy to "Download bundle" B) move secondary actions into kebab menu on desktop+mobile C) add SR announcements for copy/export D) update analytics with `export_variant`. Who can pick up frontend patch?

Marta (Eng-Frontend): I can own the patch. Will: fix tabindex, add `aria-label`s, implement role=status live region, and adjust color. Will send a tiny PR today.

Jordan (Accessibility): Quick checklist for PR: 1) `aria-label` on all icon-only controls 2) `role/status` live region with brief generic messages 3) focus order preserved (tab then arrow within menu) 4) color contrast test screenshot in PR 5) keyboard-only video clip <10s demonstrating flow.

Ava (Design): I'll update the copy files and design tokens: use "Download bundle" / "Export JSON" and a one-line helper under export: "Includes spans, logs, and attachments." Also will mock menu placement with a11y annotations.

deploy-bot: Heads up — small UI patch window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC; non-blocking.

Sam (Product): Perfect. If Marta's PR is small we can ship as a minor UI tweak. After deploy let's run quick internal a11y check and then a short hallway test with two users. Thanks everyone — feel free to ping me if you hit gotchas.

Jordan (Accessibility): I'll review the PR and sign off if checklist satisfied. Also will add the SR text suggestions in a comment.

Ava (Design): Thanks — I'll drop the updated copy in the PR too.
